note: Which lexicon-scan proposals may be published automatically once the validator verifies their evidence, and which always go to review (proposed with extraction "rule"). A founder-approved RULE, not a per-record decision. Measured on the pilot (manual audit of random published samples): ingredients ~88%, facets ~88%, sensory attributes (taste / texture / serving temperature) ~50% correct — so sensory attributes found by scanning prose are review-only until a better extractor or a better source (e.g. the merchant's own menu wording) raises that. A fact is auto-published only when at least min_supporting_sentences different sentences of the source state it (a single mention — a metaphor, a compound word, a passing list — goes to review).

measurements.sample: 100 random published facts after the Wikipedia category expansion (1,334 articles)
measurements.decision: below the 95% target -> facets and ingredients from encyclopedia prose are review-only; relations stay automatic
